Filmmakers Eric Goode and Jeremy McBride join Joe Rogan for episode 2536. The pair made the hit series Tiger King about big cat keepers. Their work mixes crime, ego, and wild animals.

They tell Rogan how they found that strange world and filmed it. Tales of private zoos and feuding owners fill the hour. The pair also discuss what the cameras missed. Listeners who loved the series get the backstory from the men who shot it, with new detail on a saga that never quite ends. The weirdness never lets the hour slow down.
